proofs.text: Call `commit_records(identity="developer")` in a repository with an upstream; verify `git log -1` names the record file, that it prints `Record committed. Run: git push` and that the remote's HEAD did not move. Repeat with a record retention deleted and verify the commit carries the deletion. Repeat with no upstream, with no remote, and with the record already at HEAD; verify each prints `Run: git push -u origin HEAD`, `Record committed.` alone and `Nothing to commit` respectively and returns without raising

rule_text: A developer's commit stages the records and the deletions retention made, commits under the developer's own git identity and never pushes: it prints `Record committed. Run: git push`, or `Run: git push -u <remote> HEAD` where the branch has no upstream, or `Record committed.` where there is no remote at all; with nothing staged it prints `Nothing to commit` and exits 0

tests.body:
def test_a_developer_commit_carries_the_deletions_retention_made(project):
    old = [put_record(project, 'greeting',
                      '2026091%dT120000Z-4f1c2ab-ada.json' % day)
           for day in range(5)]
    records_module.commit_records(project, old, 'developer', 'purlin: records')
    fresh = records_module.write_record(project, record(), 'ada@example.com')
    records_module.commit_records(project, [fresh], 'developer',
                                  'purlin: record')

    listed = git(project, 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', 'HEAD').stdout
    assert fresh in listed
    assert old[0] not in listed, 'a pruned record stayed in the commit'
tests.name: test_a_developer_commit_carries_the_deletions_retention_made

def test_nothing_to_commit_is_said_and_not_an_error(project, capsys):
    path = records_module.write_record(project, record(), 'ada@example.com')
    records_module.commit_records(project, [path], 'developer', 'purlin: one')
    capsys.readouterr()
    sha = records_module.commit_records(project, [path], 'developer',
                                        'purlin: again')
    assert sha == ''
    assert 'Nothing to commit' in capsys.readouterr().out
tests.name: test_nothing_to_commit_is_said_and_not_an_error
